godbolt_skip: repro is inherently a two-stage pipeline (compile to a DXIL container, then -link that container); Compiler Explorer runs one dxc invocation per pane against pasted HLSL source and cannot feed a compiled container into a second invocation, so the crash cannot be expressed on CE
history: always-repro'd across v1.6.2106..v1.9.2607 (for the entire lifetime of -link; v1.4.1907..v1.6.2104 reject -link as an unknown argument, before the feature existed) and on main-debug (89e2f98e2)
reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Access violation (0xC0000005, read of address 0) still crashes dxc -link when the input container was compiled as an ordinary (non-library) cs_6_3 shader, identical to the 2023 report; reproduces on every stable release since -link was introduced (v1.6.2106) through v1.9.2607 and on main (89e2f98e2). Linking the same shader compiled as a lib_6_3 library target instead does not crash, corroborating the reporter's theory that the defect is specific to non-library (createHandle) input to the linker.
title: Internal compiler error when attempting to link a non-library input
